verdict.rationale: Capacities has distinct API generations: a Beta API with a dated sunset notice (September 1, 2026) and migration instructions, and a successor API portal whose sections include "versioning". A versioned OpenAPI spec (version 1.0.0) is also published. However, the evidence shows only one specific deprecation notice, not a general documented deprecation policy with notice periods or guarantees, and the content of the versioning section is not shown. Missing for 10: a general written deprecation policy (notice windows, support guarantees), the actual versioning scheme details, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: This is the documentation for the Capacities API Beta, which will be discontinued on **September 1, 2026**. The new Capacities API is available at developers.capacities.io. Please migrate your integrations before the deprecation date.
Authentication, SDKs, versioning, rate limits, concurrency, and error handling
